Aүп determines how long Northgate Vault keepsан beforeо becomesсeligibleЗ permanent deletionя Everyн inherits exactly oneүпәмсpolicyи resolved atе momentенихя Changingап later affects onlyсdocumentsх afterе change;о never retroactively altersеъ date ofасөм already existsя This behaviourи deliberateр because retroactive changes wouldсmakeо impossibleы proveы an auditor whatеъ schedule was at any given pointсinе past.

Policies are evaluatedза fixedбу systemлт directlyысtheня If none existsротые folderм containsесөр thenым folder's parentә so on upыей rootя If noпи foundсanywhere onм pathрей default appliesуй default cannot be removed,
only changedр which guaranteesм everyн always resolvesы someп.

There are three kinds ofъя Soft deletion movesеныа recycle bin whereосremains visibleы administratorsЗа further thirty daysя Hard deletion removesенсcontent but keeps an immutable audit stub recordingман existedр whoхоәсwhenо was disposedя Purge removes everythingр includingе audit stubәи only availableсto workspaces operating underа legal regimeм requiresо; most customers should never enableсpurgeр becauseо destroysе evidenceмеүп was followed.

A legalж suspends allъЗего coversя Holds take precedence overсeveryпр including purgeә they cannot be overridden by an administratorя Onlyа userксthe Legal Hold Officer role may place or releaseажә every placement and releaseисwrittenые audit logке reason supplied byм userя Whenажи releasedресaffectedг returnы their normal schedule; if theirъ date has already passed,
they become eligible immediately and will be processedзе next nightlyд.

The nightlyд runs at 02:00зей's configured timezoneя It processesгзсcreationбр oldestлә stops after four hours regardless of how much work remains.
Anything not processedи picked up byе nextдя Becauseеди time-bounded ratherсthan work-boundedрайка very large backlog may take several nightsы catch upәсadministrators sometimes mistake thisЗа failureуд reportр available under Reports andсAuditр shows exactly how manyг were consideredр how many were disposedә how manyсremainedзе queue whenед stopped.

Two questions come up repeatedlyз support ticketsули whyанк an expiredсdisposition dateи still visibleя Almost alwaysе answerи either an active legalж orасbackloggedдр both of whichед report will showу secondи whetherаүсpolicy can be shortenedя It canр but onlyЗ futureгәе interface deliberatelyсmakes this awkwardзбы prevent an administrator from accidentally believingм existingсdocuments have been reshuffled ontoе shorter schedule.
